_about: What goes into the course's design score, shown as a checklist on the Goals panel. The points are the score: Sim.design is their sum, capped at 100, and only while at least one hole is open. A line with no points is shown and does not change the score. count lines read an amenity (visitors.gd). any lines add those amenities, plus a staff role when staff is set. each is the points per item, up to cap.

lines.next: Open another hole. A draft does not count.
lines.next_none: Open a hole. Nothing else on this list counts until one is open.

lines.next: Lay out a hole of a different par.
lines.done: The course has a par 3, a par 4 and a par 5.

lines.next: Add a drink stand, a snack bar, or a drinks cart.
lines.done: Golfers can get a drink or a bite.

lines.next: Add another bench, up to four.
Add another ball washer, up to three.

lines.done: A landmark stands on the course.
The clubhouse is as grand as it gets.

lines.next: Plant trees, flowers or water along the open holes.
lines.done: The open holes are as scenic as they can be.

lines.next: A round should come in under five hours.
lines.waiting: Play each open hole once so the round can be timed.
lines.next_none: Open a hole before a round can be timed.
lines.done: A round comes in under five hours.
